# DosePacker

> > DosePacker provides comprehensive medication management solutions and pharmacy services for long-term care, senior living, and behavioral health facilities.

DosePacker offers an integrated ecosystem of products including CareCommunityOS (senior living platform), DoseMinder (smart medication reminders), DoseKart (medical carts), and MyDoses (patient tools), alongside specialized pharmacy services including 340B program support and compliance packaging solutions for healthcare facilities across the United States.
